title: Returned Payments and Winter Protection Plan Reinstatement — Basis Q&A

# Returned Payments and Winter Protection Plan Reinstatement — Basis Q&A

**Rule.** When a defaulted Winter Protection Plan of the Payment Arrangement program is reinstated, the winter returned-payment share is 6% when two or more returned-payment charges were posted to the plan's Electric Service Agreement within the winter review window, 3% when exactly one was, and zero when none was. The winter review window is the period over which the agreement's returned-payment charges are reviewed for the reinstatement.

## Questions the rule answers

**Which charges are counted?**
The returned-payment charges on the ledger of the Electric Service Agreement that carries the winter plan, posted within the winter review window.

**What applies with exactly one returned-payment charge in the window?** 3%.

**What applies with two or more?** 6%.

**What applies when the only returned-payment charge was posted before the window began?** Zero — it is not within the window.

| Returned-payment charges in the window | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Winter returned-payment share | 0 | 3% | 6% | 6% |
